oracle: What is the last condition state we can actually prove?

rows.invariant: AUTHORITY MUST BE JURISDICTION + VERSION BOUNDED
SAME INPUTS + SAME VERSION -> SAME AUDIT RESULT
SOURCE FAILURE MUST NOT CREATE A FALSE STATE
LAST VERIFIED CLINICAL STATE MUST SURVIVE INSTITUTIONAL FAILURE
MISSING CRITICAL EVIDENCE -> UNPROVEN, NEVER ASSUMED

hard_constraints.rule: If critical condition-transition receipt evidence is absent, affected cells and downstream transition state cannot be upgraded beyond UNPROVEN.
Material disagreement between independent admissible evidence paths forces CONFLICTING until reconciled.
Administrative completion artifacts cannot independently establish RESOLVED.
Evidence items in the same independence_group count as one corroboration path regardless of copy count.
Source unavailability cannot create a new clinical state or erase the last verified clinical state.
Identical admissible inputs under the same oracle version must produce the same classical resolution output.
Every rubric cell has exactly one state.
Optimizer output is a candidate consistency assignment only and cannot directly set delta_R or clinical_resolution.

objective.form: Q(X) = w_fail*FAIL + w_unproven*UNPROVEN + w_conflict*CONFLICTING + w_dup*DUPLICATION + w_gap*PROVENANCE_GAPS
objective.weight_policy: Weights may rank otherwise-feasible candidate assignments but may not relax, replace, or overpower hard constraints.
